steps.$comment: Which rung of a 12-step ramp each job takes. Components read these by name and never write a number, so re-anchoring a job is a one-line change here instead of a sweep. Rung semantics: 1-2 page backgrounds, 3-5 component fills, 6-8 borders, 9-10 solid fills, 11-12 text.

emphasis.$comment: The four treatments, named in terms of `steps` so every rung is defined exactly once.
